result.summary: The home feed renders cleanly overall, but the bottom navigation highlights the wrong tab: "Profile" is shown as active while the screen displayed is clearly the Home feed. No other visual defects found; the clipped carousel item and the cut-off pizza card are expected scrolling behavior.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar shows the "Profile" tab in the active state (green icon and bold green label) while the screen content is the Home feed (delivery address, promo banner, restaurant lists). The "Home" tab is rendered in inactive grey, so the active indicator does not match the current screen.
issues.suggestion: Bind the active tab state to the current route so that "Home" is highlighted on the home feed and "Profile" returns to the inactive grey style.
